title: Fix flaky MetadataCache TTL expiration test
body:
CI failing on `MetadataCache.test.ts` due to timer precision causing intermittent test failure. Test expects cache entry to expire at exactly 200ms TTL but `setTimeout(100) + setTimeout(100)` can resolve at ~199ms.

## Changes

- Increased second timeout from 100ms → 110ms to guarantee 200ms TTL exceeded
- Updated test comments to reflect actual timing (210ms total)

```typescript
// Before: total ~200ms, flaky at boundary
await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 100));
await cache.get('test', fetcher);
await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 100)); // Could be <200ms total

// After: total ~210ms, reliably exceeds TTL
await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 100));
await cache.get('test', fetcher);
await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 110)); // Guaranteed >200ms
```
